onlyDraftEditable: Only a draft invoice can be edited.
customerNotFound: The billing customer no longer exists.
invoiceIncomplete: Complete all required invoice fields before marking it as sent or paid.
invalidServicePeriod: The service period end must be after its start.
invoiceNumberExists: An invoice with this number already exists.
cannotMarkSent: This invoice cannot be marked as sent.
cannotMarkPaid: Only a sent or overdue invoice can be marked as paid.
paymentReferenceConflict: This invoice is already paid with a different payment reference.
paidAtInFuture: The payment date cannot be in the future.
cannotVoidPaid: A paid invoice cannot be voided. Record a credit or refund separately.
onlyTerminalArchivable: Only a paid or void invoice can be removed from the operational table.
